elena-revops: Heads-up — NordEdge (acct N-881) submitted a formal dispute for the Apr 12 invoice. They say embeddings were double-counted during a 90m window and want a reconciliation + refund.
matt-sales: CSM forwarded their logs. They show repeated client SDK retries around 2026-04-12T10:15:00Z. Asking for an estimate and ETA on resolution.
tom-engr: I pulled gateway traces. We saw a burst where the upstream rate_limiter returned 429 and the gateway retried requests with new request_ids. Our metering currently treats each incoming request_id as billable, so client-side retries created duplicate embed events. Short term, that inflates billed embed units.
ops-lead: Do we have dedupe keys? We log client_provided_id in 80% of requests; we can use that to dedupe in ledger.
julie-billing: Can you run a delta query to compute duplicates and dollar impact? We need a precise number for the credit memo.
tom-engr: Running quick aggregation now. Query: ```-- detect duplicate embed events by client_provided_id in window
SELECT client_provided_id, count(*) as occurrences, sum(tokens) as tokens_total
FROM embed_event_log
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '2026-04-12T10:00:00Z' AND '2026-04-12T11:30:00Z'
GROUP BY client_provided_id
HAVING count(*) > 1;```
Query result (sample): duplicates_found=87 rows, duplicated_tokens=456789, estimated_refund_usd=4567.89 (at $0.01 per 100 tokens equivalent). This is preliminary — full ledger reconcile may shift cents.
devops-bot: refund-job-created RB-20260412-DEDUPE check-run scheduled: https://jobs.internal/runs/RB-20260412-DEDUPE (canary then full).
julie-billing: Julie-billing can approve refunds up to $5,000 without director sign-off. This looks within threshold. Need memo text & affected invoice lines to post GL entry.
elena-revops: Proposal: issue a manual refund of $4,567.89 to NordEdge, mark it as provisional, then run RB-20260412-DEDUPE to validate. If the backfill reduces the duplicate tokens further, we'll adjust with a follow-up memo.
matt-sales: I'll notify CSM and NordEdge: "We're issuing a provisional refund of $4,567.89 for duplicated embed charges on Apr 12. We'll verify with an internal dedupe job and confirm within 48 hours." :raised_hands: 
tom-engr: Also pushing a code fix: add 30s dedupe window at router and emit dedupe_hash to metering events so ledger can detect duplicates at ingestion. Will open PR and link it here.
julie-billing: Approved. Julie-billing approves manual refund of $4,567.89 to NordEdge (N-881). Please attach CSV of duplicate client_provided_id rows and the job run id for audit.
ops-lead: Backfill started in canary. Job id BF-20260412-dedupe created. Runbook: RB-dedupe-embed-001. ETA full verify in 6 hours.
matt-sales: Sending customer note now and CC'ing finance. Will update when they acknowledge.
elena-revops: Thanks. Once the GL posts, tag me and I'll close the dispute ticket. If the reconcile changes the amount, we'll handle an adjustment memo.
